# mutations

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/docker/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/docker/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

Docker-owned exact container lifecycle intent values.

`connectors_docker.mutations` is one of connectors_docker's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `ContainerLifecycleAction`

`connectors_docker.mutations.ContainerLifecycleAction` is one of `start`, `stop` and `restart`.

### `ContainerLifecycleIntent`

`connectors_docker.mutations.ContainerLifecycleIntent` is a record of seven fields:

- `instance_ref` — `String`
- `connection_ref` — `String`
- `container_selector` — `String`
- `expected_container_id` — `String`
- `action` — `connectors_docker.mutations.ContainerLifecycleAction`
- `stop_signal` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `stop_timeout_seconds` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent

Every value satisfies `(not (action == start) or (not (defined(stop_signal)) and not (defined(stop_timeout_seconds))))`, `(action == start or (defined(stop_signal) and defined(stop_timeout_seconds)))`, `(not (defined(stop_timeout_seconds)) or (stop_timeout_seconds >= 0 and stop_timeout_seconds <= 10))` and `(not (defined(stop_signal)) or (stop_signal.count >= 1 and stop_signal.count <= 32))`.

One of the types above is reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_docker.mutations.ContainerLifecycleIntent`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names it, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
